address: 4 The Polygon, Clapham, London, SW4 0JG, United Kingdom
bio: Joy and generosity are the tent-poles of this casual sharing plates restaurant situated above its slightly more formal and luxurious sibling. The open-plan kitchen is the focus of the intimate dining room, where everyone sits at high tables and the sound of good cheer fills the air. The visually appealing dishes are packed with distinct, hugely satisfying flavours; many are cooked over fire, like terrific Cornish squid with chickpeas and saffron aioli. Pricing is fair and the service is charming....
